snapshot.name: ak:mcp-builder
snapshot.description: Build, upgrade, test and publish MCP servers that expose external services as tools. Covers MCP spec 2026-07-28, TypeScript SDK v2 and Python mcp v2 (MCPServer), tool design, OAuth, evaluations and the MCP Registry.
snapshot.when_to_use: Invoke when building, migrating or reviewing an MCP server or its tool surface; not for configuring MCP clients or calling existing servers.
